## Checklist

- [ ] Target branch is `dev` (features) or `dev → master` (release)
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `chore:`) — Release Please builds the changelog and the next version number from these
- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes locally
- [ ] `version` in `build.gradle` is untouched — Release Please owns it
- [ ] `dev → master` is merged with a merge commit, never a squash
